# B2B Ranch

> B2B Ranch is a Quarter Horse breeding and training ranch in Três Rios, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, focused on barrel racing (Três Tambores). Founded by Odilon and Maria Izabel (Bebel) Diniz.

Phone and WhatsApp: +55 (24) 99944-2266
Email: contato@b2branch.com.br
Languages: Portuguese (https://b2branch.com.br/), English (https://b2branch.com.br/en/)
